name: Bethuel
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: Jacob was sent to Laban, the son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah. Rebekah herself was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother; the family line was kept in place, generation after generation going back to their own kindred.

note.label: Genesis 28: The Charge and the Vow at Bethel
